subject: [PATCH] mm/huge_memory: transfer the pmd dirty bit to the folio on zap

reviews.author: Lance Yang
reviews.summary: reviewer clarified the expected behavior of PMD-order file folios and suggested a way to avoid whole-folio write amplification by dirtying only blocks corresponding to faulting PTEs
reviews.raw_body:
Just checking I got it right ... for a PMD-order file folio:

read-only mapping  -> PMD-mapped
writable mapping   -> PTE-mapped

Then ->page_mkwrite() could dirty only blocks corresponding to faulting
PTE, avoiding whole-folio write amplification.

Is that what you have in mind?

Cheers, Lance

2026-08-21.patch_summary: This patch transfers the pmd dirty bit to the folio during a zap operation, ensuring that write batching from large folios remains a win and fixing issues related to delayed rmap on PTE level.
